analysis: The supplied changes to docs/developer/test.md are documentation-only: the date bump on line 3 and a new section on focused Gemma 4 tensor-parallel checks. The patch excerpt says the new section adds 115 lines at 1231-1345, but the supplied head text stops at line 921, and the patch excerpt is truncated mid-list. I could not review the new section in full. What I could see describes synthetic weights on one Mac over loopback only, with no real-weight numerics or pair qualification, so it opens no new provider attack surface. No code, key handling, attestation, coordinator protocol, prefix-cache, fan-helper or add-on hold behavior changes in the visible text. The visible text of the test guide repeatedly keeps tests isolated from production state, for example `DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR`, ephemeral-key cache runs, `env -i` scrubbing and the 'never use production cache roots/keys' warning. Nothing in it weakens the T-041 cache posture or the TB-011, TB-012 or T-053 contracts. The Gemma tensor-parallel loopback checks run unauthenticated rank-to-rank traffic only in a test context. Any later production exposure of the Gemma tensor-parallel transport on a real cluster interface would need threat-model review, since this document does not cover that surface. Remaining question for integration: the truncated hunk at head lines 1231-1345 is not visible here, so a pass that sees the full file should check it for anything beyond test instructions, such as commands that touch real credentials or provider state.
